"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to incentivizing states to adopt progressive funding formulas that direct resources to the schools that need it most.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure sustainable, reliable funding for rural schools, schools in impoverished urban areas impacted by gentrification, and Bureau of Indian Education schools.",
